body_html:
A clean-lined, hardworking surface that drops into training rooms, breakout spaces, and busy offices without fuss. The Offices To Go work table pairs a durable 1" thermally fused laminate top with a black metal skirt and sturdy metal legs, giving you a finished look that holds up to everyday institutional use. Leveling glides keep it steady on uneven floors, and it ships easy-to-assemble in a single carton.

Features

  • 1" high-performance thermally fused laminate top with a durable self edge
  • Black powder-coated metal skirt for a clean, finished appearance
  • Metal legs with leveling glides for stability on uneven flooring
  • Rectangular top suited to work, training, and multipurpose rooms
  • Ships easy-to-assemble in one carton
  • 60"x30" available on quick ship; 72"x30" and 72"x36" on a 3-week lead time

Specifications

Quick-ship size measures 60"W x 30"D x 29"H, with 72"W x 30"D and 72"W x 36"D also available. Backed by a 5-year limited warranty on non-moving structural parts through the Offices To Go warranty program. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964, 296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and finish options, or call 1-800-835-9565.
